package.name: uavx_gcs
package.description:
The ground station, as a node in the graph like any other.
Round 2 found that leaving it out of the topology invited an implementer to wire it straight to every router, which would make every delivery ratio in this repository a measurement of nothing. It sits at the origin of the frozen frame, it holds one tx endpoint and one rx endpoint, and it reaches the swarm only through the radio. Deduplication of delivered observations happens here and on the pair (origin_id, sequence), which is what makes delivered once a set comparison rather than a count.
